integrity: An algebraic rank proof covers every field and partition; finite exhaustive verification is corroborative only. Prior one-block distribution is credited. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on a fixed nilpotent reduction over the square-zero ring of finite dual numbers; does not cover higher nilpotent base rings or characterize lifted Jordan modules. Brawley 1982 full article could not be inspected completely; unindexed equivalent tangent-map results remain a residual originality risk.
title: Nilpotency-index distribution for arbitrary nilpotent Jordan types over finite dual numbers
